# Copilot instructions

The guide for AI agents and contributors to this repository is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), at the repository root. Read it before you change anything: it covers the project, the repository layout, the commands, the CI checks and how to run them, where each kind of content goes, the gotchas, and the pull request and commit conventions.

Copilot code review on GitHub.com, the Copilot cloud agent, Copilot CLI and Copilot Chat in VS Code read AGENTS.md directly. This file is for the Copilot features that read only this path, such as Copilot Chat on GitHub.com and code review in an IDE, so keep it to this pointer and make changes in AGENTS.md.
